{"blockedBy":{"nodes":[],"totalCount":0},"body":"## Parent

#644

## What to build

A lane ticket names the skills its worker must load, and the supervisor sees at hand-off which of them the worker never loaded.

- The to-tickets ticket template gains a `## Skills` section holding one column-0 line, `Skills: <skill>, <skill>` or `Skills: none`. A line set later is posted as a ticket comment in the same form, as `Seam:` lines are (issue-view --notes); the latest one counts.
- `octo-feather-lane ticket` and `tickets` fail a named skill that the implementer's role is not offered (as `pi-role` resolves it, `{tracker}` included).
- When the target's `.octo-feather.toml` sets `skills_line = "required"`, they also fail a ticket with no Skills line. `optional` lets a ticket omit it, and is the code default until the owner decides.
- A new `octo-feather-lane skills TICKET` compares the ticket's Skills line with the Pi session of the ticket's worker. It finds that session from the latest spawn line for the ticket in the caller's lane hand-off log, and reads it with the skill-reach reader the factory report uses: a load, never a mention.
  - It prints one line per named skill: `loaded`, `not loaded` or `not offered`.
  - It appends one finding line per miss to the lane log: source `skills`, class `skill-not-loaded`, with ticket and skill.
  - `.octo-feather.toml` `skill_miss` decides the outcome. `record` (the code default until the owner decides) logs the miss as non-blocking and exits 0. `send-back` logs it as blocking, exits 1, and prints the fix: send the worker back to load the skill before integrate.
- The supervisor role runs it when it consumes a worker's result (one entry in its role file).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] issue-lifecycle#acceptance-ticket-skills: a worker hands off without loading a skill its ticket names, and the lane's hand-off log records the miss naming the ticket and the skill; under `skill_miss = "send-back"` the command exits 1 telling the supervisor to send the worker back
- [ ] issue-lifecycle#acceptance-tracer-tickets: `octo-feather-lane ticket` fails a draft naming a skill the implementer is not offered, and, under `skills_line = "required"`, a draft with no Skills line, each with its class and fix
- [ ] demo: `scripts/octo-feather-lane skills 1094` prints, for the pilot's worker session, each skill #1094 names as loaded or not loaded

## Seams

Seam: issue-lifecycle#acceptance-ticket-skills: `octo-feather-lane skills`
Seam: issue-lifecycle#acceptance-tracer-tickets: `octo-feather-lane ticket`

## Skills

Skills: tdd, codebase-design

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately)
